prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving interface–outbound-load release; objectives accuracy/committed dispatch/safety/inventory compliance; no explicit modes. Warehouse Management System (Morrowglass): authoritative inventory/location/eligibility/expected shipments/task state/priorities; reconciles movements; plans capacity/windows/staging; produces Slot Reservation Receipt (position/validation), sends Dispatch Wave Amendment on destination/priority/sequence changes. Allocations require availability/access/count/inspection/door-release, dimensions/mass/compatibility/retrievability/clearance/restricted-handling approval; exclude conflicts, favor short fast-stock paths. Yard Gate Controller (Velvetrook): records arrivals; validates vehicle/carrier/trailer against receiving plan; directs access/staging/doors. Drivers obey directions; unscheduled arrivals reviewed; unavailable assignments held safely. Inbound Inspection Desk (Cinderbay): checks identifiers/seals/paperwork/expected shipment before unloading authorization; records exceptions, segregates damage, reconciles counts before completion; sends Trailer Seal Exception Note. Receiving closes after count/status/door-release recording. Pallet Dimension Scanner (Moonquarry): measures height/width/length; verifies suitability; produces Oversize Load Advisory, not placement authorization; supports oversized routing/handling. Inbound Pallet Buffer holds accepted pallets. North Aisle Stacker Crane (Juniperwake)/South Aisle Stacker Crane: zoned storage/retrieval, valid targets/access, controlled cross-aisle moves; North sends Aisle Occupancy Snapshot; stale reports hold induction. East Transfer Conveyor/West Transfer Conveyor interface vehicle travel–outbound staging. Conveyor Line Controller (Brasshaven): separate interlocked sequences, identification/inspection prerequisite, sensor confirmation; upstream blockage holds; downstream-ready release; single-pallet merges; produces/validates Transfer Induction Ticket identifiers/routing; holds duplicates; recovery preserves order. Autonomous Forklift Fleet (Larkspur): valid vehicle/area/path; prioritizes tasks by dispatch/battery/proximity; routes respect access/transfer-readiness/pedestrians/restrictions; confirms identity/pickup; limits speed/turning; stops/reroutes under safety controls; produces completed-transfer Forklift Handoff Confirmation (vehicle/pallet/time/receiving-position/incomplete/deferred movements). Fire Alarm Panel produces Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice. Outbound Dispatch Sorter receives/applies authorized amendments, preserves order unless explicitly changed, verifies staging. Outbound Checkweigh Scale verifies weight; Shipping Documentation Desk prepares confirmed pallet/destination records. Warehouse

New part:
S128: Yard Gate Controller records unresolved discrepancies for review and prevents an affected vehicle from proceeding when the discrepancy creates an operating risk.
S129: Yard Gate Controller uses the exception note to manage a receiving discrepancy at the gate.
S130: The receiving exception remains visible to the Warehouse Operations Supervisor until the discrepancy has been assessed and resolved.
S131: Inbound Inspection Desk records inspection outcomes before pallets enter routine warehouse handling.
S132: Inbound Pallet Buffer provides a controlled staging point when inspection or downstream handling is not yet ready.
S133: Pallet Dimension Scanner supplies measurements used to identify pallets that require a different handling path.
S134: Conveyor Line Controller coordinates conveyor movement and stops affected equipment when a downstream condition prevents safe transfer.
S135: East Transfer Conveyor and West Transfer Conveyor provide separate routes for moving pallets between operating areas.
S136: Autonomous Forklift Fleet receives work only when a route and destination are available for the assigned vehicle.
S137: North Aisle Stacker Crane and South Aisle Stacker Crane report operating availability so task allocation can account for equipment status.
S138: The Warehouse Operations Supervisor can defer work when a route conflict, equipment fault, or staging constraint remains unresolved.
S139: Maintenance Release Terminal is also known as Copperfield.
S140: Maintenance Release Terminal produces the Crane Service Release Card after required maintenance checks have been completed.
S141: Maintenance authorization is recorded before affected equipment is returned to operational service.
S142: Morrowglass reconciles work across operating areas and preserves a consistent view of task status and outstanding constraints.
S143: Outbound Dispatch Sorter organizes completed pallets according to the current shipping plan.
S144: Outbound Checkweigh Scale verifies shipment weight before the shipping record is finalized.
S145: Shipping Documentation Desk prepares shipment records from confirmed pallet and destination data.
S146: Fire Alarm Panel and Safety Zone Controller provide safety status that can require movement to stop or be restricted.
S147: Warehouse Operations Supervisor reviews delayed tasks, abnormal vehicle stops, and unresolved staging constraints before releasing the next outbound wave.
S148: Exception handling preserves a traceable hold state until the source of a discrepancy is understood and the affected pallet can be safely routed.
S149: A mismatch between expected and observed pallet attributes prevents automatic allocation and directs the load to controlled review.
S150: The operating record retains the scan result, location, and time of detection so that the review can be reconstructed.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
